name: Romero and Juliette
description: Reunite Romero and Juliette by running their errands across SkyBlock.

juliette.name: Juliette
juliette.hint: Juliette always stands in the same spot on Jungle Island.

steps.title: Talk to Juliette
steps.hint: Jungle Island - Juliette never moves, she is always here.
advance_on: He wears glasses and blends well in a crowd!

steps.title: Find Romero in the cave
steps.hint: Savanna Woodland, in a cave under Master Tactician Funk.
advance_on: Could you find some gold for me, please?

steps.title: Bring 1x Yellow Rock to Romero
steps.hint: Mine gold ore in the Savanna caves - do NOT use Silk Touch.
advance_on: Here, could you do me a favor and bring this gift back to Juliette?

steps.title: Bring the Poorly Wrapped Rock to Juliette
advance_on: He said he was getting groceries at the downtown markets.

steps.title: Find Romero at the flower house
advance_on: Could you help out and get some flowers?

steps.title: Bring 15x Poppy to Romero
advance_on: Please bring the bouquet to Juliette!

steps.title: Bring the Rose Bouquet to Juliette
advance_on: He's at some sort of emerald altar...

steps.title: Find Romero at the Emerald Altar
steps.hint: Graveyard, on the left at the Emerald Altar.
advance_on: Could you bring me some emerald?

steps.title: Bring 64x Emerald to Romero
advance_on: Now bring this gift to Juliette!

steps.title: Bring the Fake Emerald Altar to Juliette
steps.hint: Juliette has no unique line here - she simply sends you on.
advance_on: Hey, you again!

steps.title: Find Romero on the Crimson Isle
steps.hint: Near the entrance, in an underground nether wart farm.
advance_on: I need some decent mushrooms.

steps.title: Bring 1x Enchanted Red Mushroom Block to Romero
advance_on: There's some stew for Juliette!

steps.title: Bring the Mushroom & Warts Stew to Juliette
advance_on: Go find him!

steps.title: Find Romero on the Mountain
steps.hint: Wooden platform on the side of the ruins.
advance_on: I wish I could jump like a Rabbit and grab a chunk of it.

steps.title: Bring 1x Rabbit VI Potion to Romero
steps.hint: Brew it with Cheap or Decent Coffee. Must NOT be a splash potion.
advance_on: Bring the chunk to Juliette!

steps.title: Bring the Chunk of the Moon to Juliette
advance_on: Please find him, wherever that is!

steps.title: Find Romero in the Gold Mine
steps.hint: Steeply down on the left, next to a campfire.
advance_on: Now I just need enough heat to melt it!

steps.title: Bring 1x Enchanted Lava Bucket to Romero
advance_on: Can you please bring this one to Juliette?

steps.title: Bring the Secret Gift to Juliette
advance_on: He told me he's in his home.

steps.title: Find Romero in the treehouse
steps.hint: Wilderness, the highest treehouse near Tia the Fairy.
advance_on: Going to need someone wicked smart to solve it.

steps.title: Reach 1,291 Intelligence and talk to Romero
advance_on: Please, bring it to Juliette and show her how smart I am.

steps.title: Bring the Solved Rubix Prism to Juliette
advance_on: Can you find Romero before he hurts himself?

steps.title: Find Romero in the Colosseum
steps.hint: Left side, under a path (the armoury).
advance_on: I'll need my favorite weapon, can you fetch it for me?

steps.title: Bring 1x Emerald Blade to Romero
advance_on: Please bring this poem to Juliette.

steps.title: Bring the Poem of True Love to Juliette
advance_on: Please find him, I'm worried!

steps.title: Find Romero in the Mushroom Desert
steps.hint: In a small house - the smallest house in SkyBlock.
advance_on: I need a ridiculous amount of flowers.

steps.title: Bring 1x Flower Minion to Romero
advance_on: With this, I can get enough flowers to win Juliette back!

steps.title: Bring the Flower Maelstrom to Juliette
advance_on: We're making it official!

steps.title: Wear a Tuxedo and talk to Romero
steps.hint: Romero stands next to Juliette on Jungle Island. The cheapest 3m set is enough.
advance_on: Please, one last time, give this to Juliette.

steps.title: Give the final gift to Juliette
advance_on: We can't thank you enough for bringing us together!
